about: Uzhhorod: Czech functionalism, the Uzh and the mountains nearby

Uzhhorod stands out for its interwar Czechoslovak architecture — functionalist buildings with clean lines and large windows, especially in the Malyi Halahov district. Nearby are the old town, new complexes on the Uzh and private houses with gardens.

The mild climate and the closeness of the EU border make Transcarpathia attractive both for living and for hospitality: guest houses, mini-hotels, wine estates. We run such properties as commercial projects, with a concept, an estimate and furnishing.

In Czech-era buildings the interior brings out their character: simple forms, quality materials, original windows and stairs kept. For guest houses — a design that withstands a flow of guests and is easy to maintain; see also [hotel design](/en/hotel-design-fit-out). Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate apartments in older buildings and new builds, houses and small commercial premises. In Transcarpathia we build private houses and guest complexes from aerated block, brick, logs or timber frame, taking slopes and drainage into account.

Renovation is carried out by our salaried team: from $550 per m² for works and rough materials, with finishing materials, furniture and appliances priced separately per estimate. Scope, schedule and payment plan (50/50, 50/30/20 or in stages, from a 10% advance) are fixed in the contract; team travel is on individual terms. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m² — see [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Design and approvals run online; we travel for measurements and key stages on the schedule set in the contract, and the terms and costs of travel and team accommodation are individual. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks, and an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.
